      Methodology

      A disciplined path from question to change.

      The four stages keep evidence, judgement and ownership connected.

      01

      Map. Define the operating question, process boundaries, stakeholders and decision context.

      02

      Measure. Bring quantitative and qualitative evidence into one reviewable structure.

      03

      Diagnose. Test patterns, materiality and causal hypotheses rather than treating symptoms as answers.

      04

      Rebuild. Turn insight into an owned plan, management cadence and measurable outcome.

      Trust and data

      Designed for responsible operational use.

      JourneyIQ strengthens human judgement. It does not replace accountability or conceal the basis of a recommendation.
